messages:
deploybot: Canary rollout scheduled: schema migration 'add_user_email_idx' -> prod-db-cluster. Window 12:00-12:30 UTC. Canary=5% traffic, app pinned to v2.4.1 for canary. Holdpoint: backfill_count=200k OR 12:10 UTC. Rollback triggers listed in thread.

alice: 👋 kicking this off now. migration script version=2026-03-21_01. DB shard set: user_shards [0-7].

matt: ack. i'll watch for lock waits and pg_locks growth. i'll be on standby for quick rollback.

jess: watching infra metrics (latency/cpu/replication). if replication lag >30s for >2 replicas, we abort.

oncall-sre: noted. my threshold matrix: error-rate >1.5% sustained 5m OR p99 increase >300ms => escalate. also abort if deadlocks >3/min.

alice: also adding an app-side pin: frontend and api pinned to v2.4.1 during canary. no schema-dependent migrations on hot paths.

matt: quick command for rollback if we need it: `/deploybot abort 6172839450 --reason "canary abort"` and `/deploybot rollback db:2026-03-21_01`. keep that handy.

jess: running a small smoke query loop to validate common paths: `SELECT id,email FROM users WHERE active=true LIMIT 10;` will run every 30s. will paste failures here.

alice: ETA for first backfill batch ~2m. I'll post counts.

DeployBot: Canary started on prod-db-01 (5% traffic). Migration step: create_index_async started.

matt: saw initial lock spikes on prod-db-01: avg lock wait 120ms -> ok. watching trend.

jess: smoke loop ok for two runs. p95 latency +40ms, p99 +120ms (within expected).

alice: backfill count: 54k rows processed. continuing.

matt: heads-up: one replica reporting lag ~22s but stable. tracking.

oncall-sre: if lag hits 30s we cut canary and failover.

jess: hitting a transient deadlock on shard 3 (1/10 runs). not persistent but logging.

alice: increasing lock backoff in migration to 200ms for shard 3, requeueing next chunk.

matt: good mitigation. if deadlocks continue >3/min we abort.

alice: backfill count: 203k — hitting holdpoint. pausing at holdpoint for 2m to assess.

jess: running an extended check now (5m window). so far error-rate 0.4%, p99 regressions stabilized.

oncall-sre: replication lag peaked 28s earlier, now 18s. no abort.

matt: lock waits trending down after backoff change. looks safe.

alice: i'm resuming final index apply after holdpoint. will monitor for 5m.

DeployBot: Canary reached 100% of canary group completed. Final index apply running.

jess: all smoke queries passing 10/10. no new errors.

matt: rolling canary to 20% per plan (manual step). pin retained.

oncall-sre: marking this window green from SRE side. ready to promote if product agrees.

alice: prepping release notes snippet: "Added index on users.email to improve lookup latency. Backfill performed during maintenance window; pinned app v2.4.1 during canary." will drop to release-notes channel after promote.

matt: i'm going to unpin app on canary group only after full rollout. leaving global pin until post-checks.

jess: final rollback criteria recap (for the record):
- error-rate >1.5% for 5m
- deadlocks >3/min sustained
- replication lag >30s on >1 replica
- any migration step exceeding expected duration by >10m
If any hit, `/deploybot abort` and DB rollback script `/deploybot rollback db:2026-03-21_01`.

alice: agreed. pushing final apply.

DeployBot: Canary complete. Promote ready. To promote run `/deploybot promote 6172839450 --to=100%`.

matt: i'm good to promote, will watch the rollout.

oncall-sre: i'll keep SLO dashboards open for 30m post-promote. ping me oncall if anything weird.

jess: i'll run the smoke suite for full rollout too.

alice: promoting now. doing staggered waves per runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mig-hold

DeployBot: Promotion started. Wave 1 -> 40% traffic.

matt: wave1 healthy. no locks or spikes.

jess: smoke OK wave1.

matt: wave2 -> 70% healthy.

matt: wave3 -> 100% healthy. rollout finished.

oncall-sre: marking postmortem watch for 2h but no immediate action.

alice: release notes posted. thanks team. :tada:
